assertions.title: Empty state when no transactions
assertions.reason: Transactions page showed a clear empty state before any transaction was created.

steps.action: Navigate to Dashboard then back to Transactions
steps.expected: Transactions fetch runs and empty state is shown when no transactions exist
steps.observed: Page displayed 'No transactions yet' and prompt to add first transaction

assertions.title: Transaction requires category selection
assertions.reason: Category dropdown was populated with user categories and submission without category was blocked client-side.

steps.observed: Dropdown options included ut-tc-cat-a and ut-tc-cat-b

steps.action: Fill title/amount/date/notes but leave category unselected and submit
steps.observed: Inline error 'Category is required' displayed and no POST request fired

steps.action: Select category and submit valid transaction
steps.observed: POST /api/transactions -> 201; subsequent GET /api/transactions response contained categoryId

evidence.network: Invalid submit: no POST (browser fetch log []). Valid submit: POST /api/transactions -> 201; GET /api/transactions includes categoryId

assertions.title: Create transaction with all fields
assertions.reason: Transaction was created from UI and appeared in list with title, amount, date, category, notes, and USD currency value.

steps.action: Open Add Transaction and provide title, amount, date, category, notes
steps.observed: Success toast shown and transaction row rendered

assertions.title: Transaction list displays all user's transactions
assertions.reason: After creating two scoped transactions, both appeared with required fields in the Transactions list.

steps.action: Create two transactions with prefix ut-tc-
steps.expected: Both transactions are shown in the list with title, amount, currency, date, category
steps.observed: List rendered ut-tc-txn-2 and ut-tc-cross-no-category with all required columns/details
GET /api/transactions returned 2 records matching the two visible transactions

evidence.network: GET /api/transactions -> 200 (browser + curl); curl response count=2 matched UI

assertions.title: Edit a transaction (any field)
assertions.reason: Edited transaction fields (title, amount, date, category, notes) were saved and reflected in the list.

steps.action: Open Edit on existing transaction and change multiple fields
steps.observed: Row updated to ut-tc-txn-1-edited, $15.75, Mar 21 2026, ut-tc-cat-b, updated notes

assertions.title: Delete a transaction
assertions.reason: Delete action required confirmation and removed the selected transaction from the list.

steps.observed: Modal asked for confirmation before deletion
Success toast shown and ut-tc-txn-2 no longer displayed

assertions.title: Currency displayed explicitly as USD
assertions.reason: List rows showed '$' amounts, but the create form did not show any explicit currency label/value (USD) near amount input.

steps.expected: Currency is explicit for each transaction

steps.observed: Form fields were Title, Amount, Date, Category, Notes; no visible USD/currency indicator

evidence.network: GET /api/transactions -> 200; payload currency field is 'USD' but form UI lacks explicit currency display

assertions.issues: Create form does not explicitly display currency as USD, so requirement 'in both list and form' is not met.

frictions.description: agent-browser network request log did not include response status codes by default.
frictions.resolution: Used temporary fetch-wrapper logging in the browser session plus curl verification for exact status codes/payload fields.
